north_star: Multi-game creator assistant: turn long gameplay VODs into ranked short-form content opportunities for TikTok audience growth, then use that audience as a path toward livestreaming.
current_goal: Ship Creator Candidate Pack Beta (C1) across multiple gameplay archetypes before building AI rough editing (C2).
